dispute.claim_text: Punggol to Raffles Place is 15.8 km. The app charged me for 20.2 km because the driver went off to Hougang in the middle of my trip for no reason. I know it is a pool booking but I did not agree to a 28% longer route. $26.83 for a pool trip is more than I would have paid for a normal one.

counterparty_statement.text: It is a pool booking. The system matched a second passenger at Hougang and routed me there, I just drove what the app showed me. I cannot refuse a match.

admissibility.notes: Trip record complete and causally ordered. vehicle_type is RYDE_POOL, optimal_distance_km of 19.40 is the MATCHED-ITINERARY quote and solo_optimal_distance_km of 15.80 is the unmatched one carried for reference; POL-RD-12 turns entirely on which of the two is cited.
